tasks.summary: An option on an option (e.g. a call on a call). ORE has no CompoundOption trade type (confirmed absent from OREData portfolio and databuilders.cpp), while QuantLib provides QuantLib::CompoundOption (ql/instruments/compoundoption.hpp) and QuantLib::AnalyticCompoundOptionEngine (ql/pricingengines/exotic/analyticcompoundoptionengine.hpp). The task is to wire that existing pricing into a new ORE trade, following the existing vanilla-option pattern.
tasks.prompt:
ORE (the Open Source Risk Engine) does not currently support a CompoundOption trade type. A CompoundOption is an option on an option. QuantLib already provides the underlying pricing: the class QuantLib::CompoundOption and the engine QuantLib::AnalyticCompoundOptionEngine.

Using ONLY the ORE knowledge-graph context provided below (describing the existing ORE codebase and its subsystems), write a concrete implementation plan to add CompoundOption as a new ORE trade, mirroring how existing vanilla options are implemented. For every step, name the ORE subsystem it belongs to and the file(s)/class(es) involved. Cover: the new Trade subclass and its build(); XML serialization (fromXML/toXML); registration in the trade factory; the EngineBuilder subclass and its registration in the engine factory; construction of the QuantLib instrument and pricing engine; and the trade XML schema. Be concrete and do not invent subsystems that are not implied by the context or standard ORE/QuantLib layout.
